column1: # The library ports ps2_library_tests.cpp checks against AI's recompiled originals (tests/CMakeLists.txt builds
# those, traced). name, role, the port's source:
#   port    a readable port, run against its original on the same inputs
#   callee  what a port or its original calls: its original, in both runs
#   system  the system, the heap and fflush under the library: the test's own (ps2_library_tests.cpp), in both runs
#   data    a global the tests read
